title: Victor Lagno arXiv paper backs Pais room-temperature superconductor

tellings.quote: he showed that my room temperature superc conductor from a mechanism point of view could work and yet the the patent examiner just refused to grant the patent.

plain: Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist known for patents on unusual technology, says a paper by Victor Lagno of the Russian Academy of Sciences, posted on arXiv (an online archive where scientists share papers), showed that his design for a room-temperature superconductor, a material that carries electricity with no loss without being chilled, "could work" in principle. Pais tells Michels this himself, and adds that the patent examiner still "just refused to grant the patent", which he takes as a sign that his idea was rejected despite outside support.
